mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances; gemfibrozil may increase foscarnet levels through renal clearance impairment, and combined use increases risk of acute kidney injury and hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly magnesium and calcium), and urinalysis regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antiviral if possible or reduce foscarnet dose if renal impairment develops.
